name: WEEKDAY
shortDescription: Extract day of week from date
description: Returns the day of the week for a date (0=Monday, 6=Sunday).

examples.title: Get weekday
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM events WHERE WEEKDAY(event_date) IN (5, 6)

notes: Returns 0-6 (Monday=0, Sunday=6), as MySQL's WEEKDAY does
DAYOFWEEK is an alias with the SAME numbering -- unlike MySQL's DAYOFWEEK, which returns 1-7 (Sunday=1, Saturday=7)
